jobs.description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: B Driver with progression to CE
jobs.description:
Do you want to become a truck driver and gradually work your way up to a CE driving licence? With our client, you will have the opportunity to learn the profession and develop your skills step by step.

As a B driver for this major logistics company, you will help ensure that food products are delivered safely and on time to customers every day. You will start by making deliveries with a van and receive guidance and training to obtain your CE driving licence.

- You drive a van as a B driver and make deliveries
- You learn the routes, customers and working methods
- You actively help with loading and unloading goods
- You check your load and ensure correct delivery
- You are in daily contact with customers and represent the company
- You follow training to progress to a CE driver position
- You accurately complete transport documents
- You work according to all safety and hygiene regulations

You will join a professional environment where you are guided step by step in your development. This is your opportunity to become a skilled truck driver with plenty of opportunities for further growth.

During the onboarding period, you will work in the warehouse in a two-shift system. If this period goes well, you will start the training and receive a contract with the company.
- Vaardigheden:
You are motivated to become a truck driver
You are open to a training programme towards obtaining your CE driving licence
You are responsible and calm in traffic
You are customer-friendly and communicate fluently
You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety

- Attesten:
You hold a valid B driving licence.

/

Previous experience as a driver is an advantage

- Talenkennis:
You speak and understand English well

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - Saturday or weekdays
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Primary Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and refine yeast extract-driven solutions for a variety of savory food applications, including soups, stocks, sauces, and snack flavoring systems.
 
• Drive recipe creation and continuous optimization to improve flavor intensity, enhance umami profiles, and achieve balanced taste performance.
 
• Perform sensory assessments and analyze evaluation results to support product development and strategic market positioning.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market insights into effective, scalable, and commercially viable formulations.
 
• Investigate ingredient functionality within complex food systems and resolve technical formulation issues.
 
• Carry out market intelligence activities, including competitive product reviews and emerging trend monitoring in savory applications.
 
• Provide technical support for customer projects through prototype development, problem resolution, and product demonstrations.
 
• Work closely with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to accelerate innovation initiatives and business growth.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements, quality standards, and internal product development procedures.

Profile & Expertise

 
• Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
 
• Demonstrated expertise in product formulation and application development within one or more savory segments such as soups, seasonings, sauces, or bouillons.
 
• Outstanding junior professionals with strong academic achievements, internships, or relevant project experience are welcome to apply.
 
• Solid knowledge of sensory science, flavor characterization, and sensory-driven product development.
 
• Strong understanding of ingredient performance, flavor synergy, and behavior within food systems.
 
• Capable of planning and executing experiments independently while drawing meaningful conclusions from technical data.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on formulation improvement and optimization.
 
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external clients.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer and business needs.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
 
• Availability for occasional travel across Europe for customer meetings, industry exhibitions, and knowledge-sharing sessions at the company's headquarters in China.

Core Responsibilities

 
• Develop, refine, and enhance bakery solutions utilizing yeast-based ingredients, including baker's yeast, yeast extracts, yeast proteins, and other specialty baking components.
 
• Plan and conduct practical baking trials tailored to customer needs while aligning with current European bakery market demands and consumer trends.
 
• Lead recipe formulation and continuous product optimization for breads, viennoiseries, laminated pastries, and a wide range of fermented baked goods.
 
• Deliver technical expertise and customized product solutions to strategic customers and bakery manufacturers throughout Europe.
 
• Organize and perform bakery demonstrations in customer facilities, application centers, and industry exhibitions, both for individual clients and larger groups.
 
• Translate customer specifications and commercial opportunities into scalable formulations and effective technical recommendations.
 
• Partner closely with commercial, marketing, and global R&D teams to support innovation initiatives and business growth objectives.
 
• Monitor industry developments, competitor offerings, ingredient innovations, and advances in bakery processing technologies.
 
• Ensure all development activities comply with applicable regulations, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Professional Skills

 
• Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Baking Technology, Milling Technology, or a related field. Practical bakery training or hands-on experience as a baker is highly valued.
 
• Minimum of 5 years' experience in bakery product development, ideally within premix manufacturers, industrial bakeries, or yeast ingredient companies.
 
• Strong expertise in bakery ingredient functionality, dough behavior, flour performance evaluation, and process optimization.
 
• Proven ability to design trials, analyze technical results, identify root causes, and resolve formulation challenges.
 
• Hands-on and solution-oriented professional capable of working autonomously in a laboratory and application environment.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to transform technical expertise into tangible customer benefits.
 
• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working across departments and directly with customers.
 
• Excellent presentation and communication abilities, including delivering technical training sessions, demonstrations, and customer workshops.
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, for international collaboration; knowledge of French or Dutch is considered an asset.
 
• Flexible and willing to travel across Europe for customer meetings, trade fairs, and knowledge-sharing visits to the company's headquarters in China.

Key Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and enhance yeast-protein-based solutions for a range of food applications, including sports nutrition products, plant-based dairy substitutes, and baked goods.
 
• Drive recipe development and continuous prototype improvement to achieve targeted functionality, such as texture enhancement, emulsification, gel formation, and overall product performance.
 
• Analyze sensory evaluation results and transform insights into actionable recommendations for formulation refinement and product advancement.
 
• Perform competitive product assessments and monitor industry developments related to proteins and functional ingredients.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market expectations into effective technical concepts and scalable product solutions.
 
• Provide technical expertise for customer-focused projects, including prototype preparation, issue resolution, and technical demonstrations.
 
• Partner with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to deliver innovative products aligned with business objectives.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory guidelines, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Skills

 
• Master's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, or a closely related field.
 
• Demonstrated background in product formulation and application development within food systems such as sports nutrition, plant-based alternatives, bakery products, or similar sectors. Talented early-career candidates with relevant academic projects or internship exposure are welcome to apply.
 
• Strong expertise in sensory assessment, product characterization, and structured evaluation methodologies.
 
• In-depth knowledge of ingredient performance, protein functionality, and interactions within complex food matrices.
 
• Ability to independently plan trials, execute experiments, and draw meaningful conclusions from technical findings.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities related to formulation challenges and product improvement.
 
• Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and engage with customers.
 
• Commercial awareness and the capability to translate technical innovations into business and customer benefits.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written, for international collaboration.
 
• Flexibility to travel for customer meetings, industry exhibitions throughout Europe, and knowledge-sharing activities with the headquarters in China.
